Hi Marie / Echoscale AP,

Thanks for sending the invoice and the VAT certificate. Quick notes from Redwood Finance:

- Because Echoscale is an EU entity invoicing from Luxembourg, a completed and signed W-8BEN-E will allow us to treat the payee as a foreign entity for U.S. withholding purposes (i.e., 0% source withholding for this vendor relationship) provided the form is filled correctly and the EIN/foreign TIN section is present where required.
- We do NOT need a W-9 for non-U.S. entities. You should NOT complete a W-9 unless your entity is a U.S. taxpayer.
- Please attach a completed W-8BEN-E (signed and including the foreign TIN) and confirm the legal entity name exactly matches the invoice.
- For wires: Redwood can pay in EUR (SEPA) or USD (international wire). To avoid conversion fees on our side we prefer EUR/SEPA when available. Please provide IBAN + BIC and remit contact.

I'm attaching a short checklist and our remit instructions. Once we have the W-8BEN-E and your IBAN we can schedule payment.

Attachments: redwood_remit_instructions.pdf

Best,
Rachel Kim
